Theme

Latin word

ubi

conjunction, with the indicative (perfect in narrative)

when, as soon as; whenever, when; where? where

In this lexicon

  • when

    also used · classical · Cic. Rep. 6.14: quem ubi vīdī, equidem vim lacrimārum prōfūdī (Lewis & Short); Phaedr. 1.30.1: humilēs labōrant ubi potentēs dissident

  • whenever

    also used · classical · Ter. Eun. 813: Nōlunt ubi velīs; ubi nōlīs, cupiunt ultrō.

  • where

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Rud. 238: Dīc ubi es?; Ter. Hec. 84: ubi tē oblectāstī tam diū?

  • ubi prīmum (ut prīmum, cum prīmum): as soon as

    classical

  • locus ubi aedificātur: building site

    * our formation

  • ubi gentium (ubi terrārum): where

    classical

  • ubi gentium?: world

    classical

    when I saw him, I burst into tearsCic. Rep. 6.14 (Lewis & Short)
